page_title: Songs Like X plans: Free, or Pro for $3 a month

sources.entry: Songs Like X - AI tool for creating Spotify playlists.

summary.name: Songs Like X
summary.one_liner: Songs Like X is a music discovery tool that finds songs similar to a search and saves them as playlists to Spotify or Apple Music.
use_cases: Finding songs similar to a favourite track
Building a Spotify playlist from a seed song
Saving recommended songs to Apple Music
Discovering new music from a search
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes two plans. The Free plan gives 20 recommendations per search, lets users save whole playlists to Spotify or Apple Music or save songs individually, and add songs to a Spotify queue. The Pro plan costs $3 per month and raises recommendations to 50 per search, adds the ability to tune a list by mood or in your own words, and includes Melodie, described as an AI playlist assistant. The page says users can cancel at any time with no lock-in or hidden fees.</what_it_does>
